## Project Overview

BootStrap is a reference Modular Monolith template demonstrating .NET 10 + Aspire 13 best practices — Clean Architecture per bounded context, Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, event-driven notifications (CAP + RabbitMQ), and observable local development via the Aspire dashboard.

Current bounded contexts: **Todos** (task lifecycle) and **Notifications** (email + SignalR delivery). Modules communicate exclusively via domain events — never direct project references.

## Stack

- **.NET 10** · ASP.NET Core 10 · **Aspire 13** (service orchestration + dashboard)
- **EF Core 10** + Npgsql (PostgreSQL writes) · Dapper (complex queries)
- **MediatR 12** (CQRS) · **DotNetCore.CAP** (domain events, PostgreSQL outbox, RabbitMQ transport)
- **Redis** (distributed cache) · **Seq** (structured logs) · **OpenTelemetry** (traces, metrics, logs)
- **Vue 3** + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS (`src/spa/`)
- Central Package Management (`Directory.Packages.props`) · `.editorconfig`

## Architecture

**Style:** Modular Monolith — Clean Architecture per module.
**Dependency direction:** `Domain ← Application ← Infrastructure ← Api`

Key rules:
- Domain layer is **framework-free** — no EF, no MediatR, no ASP.NET references
- Application references Domain only; Infrastructure implements Application interfaces
- Modules must NOT reference each other; use `Contracts` for shared event types
- All writes go through a `ICommand` / `ICommandHandler`; all reads through `IQuery` / `IQueryHandler`
- New patterns require an ADR in `docs/adr/` before implementation

See [ARCHITECTURE.md](./ARCHITECTURE.md) and [CONSTITUTION.md](./CONSTITUTION.md) for full detail.

## Key Constraints

- **No auth yet** — all endpoints currently open; an auth ADR is required before any production exposure
- **No CI/CD yet** — pipeline ADR pending; quality gates are manual until then
- **ArchUnit.NET** tests enforce layer isolation — violations must be fixed, not suppressed
- Secrets must NEVER appear in code, config files, logs, or API responses
- All breaking changes to `Contracts` event types require an ADR
